prBodyNotes: **Operator guidance.** This is an automated dependency pull request.
Required checks: the full CI sequence must pass (install, audit, lint, typecheck, test, build, build-storybook).
Merge policy: a human reviews and squash-merges. Auto-merge is off. Renovate never merges to `main`.
Browser verification is not required for this change unless a note below says otherwise.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

prBodyNotes: **Risk class: SECURITY.** Opened immediately from a vulnerability alert; the 7-day release-age delay is bypassed.
Review the same day for critical, within seven days for high. Squash-merge yourself once CI is green.
**Risk class: routine runtime.** Grouped patch/minor updates to production dependencies.
**Risk class: routine tooling.** Grouped patch/minor updates to development-only dependencies.
**Risk class: CI supply chain.** Actions stay pinned to a full commit SHA; the `# vX.Y.Z` annotation moves with the digest.
**Browser verification required.** This touches the cockpit UI or its build stack. Run smoke and browser checks before merging at any update size; green unit tests can hide a broken cockpit.

**Risk class: MAJOR (breaking).** Kept individual and gated behind Dependency Dashboard approval before this pull request is created. A monorepo family that must move together is approved together on the dashboard.
Browser verification required: give every major smoke and browser checks before merging; green unit tests can hide a broken cockpit.

**Risk class: toolchain.** Node runtime (sourced from `.nvmrc`) and its TypeScript definitions move together, at every update size, so typechecking always matches the runtime. A toolchain major is still gated on the Dependency Dashboard and reviewed on its own.
**Risk class: toolchain.** pnpm is maintained as its own toolchain pull request, separate from Node and from libraries.
